mapper.select: SELECT TS.SESSION_ID , TS.ROOM_ID , R.ROOM_UUID , TS.PARTICIPANT_ID , P.NICKNAME , TS.DEVICE_KEY , TS.DEST_LAT , TS.DEST_LNG , TS.STATUS , TS.LAST_DISTANCE_M , TS.STARTED_AT , TS.ARRIVED_AT FROM TRACKING_SESSION TS JOIN ROOM R ON R.ROOM_ID = TS.ROOM_ID JOIN PARTICIPANT P ON P.PARTICIPANT_ID = TS.PARTICIPANT_ID WHERE TS.SESSION_ID = #{sessionId}

SELECT TS.SESSION_ID , TS.ROOM_ID , R.ROOM_UUID , TS.PARTICIPANT_ID , P.NICKNAME , TS.DEVICE_KEY , TS.DEST_LAT , TS.DEST_LNG , TS.STATUS , TS.LAST_DISTANCE_M , TS.STARTED_AT , TS.ARRIVED_AT FROM TRACKING_SESSION TS JOIN ROOM R ON R.ROOM_ID = TS.ROOM_ID JOIN PARTICIPANT P ON P.PARTICIPANT_ID = TS.PARTICIPANT_ID WHERE TS.ROOM_ID = #{roomId} ORDER BY TS.PARTICIPANT_ID

SELECT TS.SESSION_ID , R.ROOM_UUID , P.NICKNAME , P.PREF_LAT AS START_LAT , P.PREF_LNG AS START_LNG , TS.DEST_LAT , TS.DEST_LNG FROM TRACKING_SESSION TS JOIN ROOM R ON R.ROOM_ID = TS.ROOM_ID JOIN PARTICIPANT P ON P.PARTICIPANT_ID = TS.PARTICIPANT_ID WHERE TS.DEVICE_KEY = #{deviceKey} AND TS.STATUS = 'MOVING' ORDER BY TS.SESSION_ID

SELECT LL.SESSION_ID , LL.SEQ , LL.LAT , LL.LNG , LL.DISTANCE_M FROM LOCATION_LOG LL JOIN TRACKING_SESSION TS ON TS.SESSION_ID = LL.SESSION_ID WHERE TS.ROOM_ID = #{roomId} ORDER BY LL.SESSION_ID , LL.SEQ
mapper.update: UPDATE TRACKING_SESSION SET LAST_DISTANCE_M = #{lastDistanceM} WHERE SESSION_ID = #{sessionId} AND STATUS = 'MOVING'
UPDATE TRACKING_SESSION SET STATUS = 'ARRIVED' , ARRIVED_AT = SYSDATE , LAST_DISTANCE_M = #{lastDistanceM} WHERE SESSION_ID = #{sessionId} AND STATUS = 'MOVING'
